critical_findings.title: No aria-live regions for SSE-driven notifications, unread badge, or connection status (WCAG 4.1.3)
critical_findings.fix: Wrap notification list in role="log" aria-live="polite"; role="status" on unread badge and the 'Connecting to daemon…' pane in App.tsx:146

critical_findings.title: Health online/offline state invisible to assistive tech — aria-hidden color dot plus title that never computes into the accessible name (WCAG 1.4.1, 4.1.2)
critical_findings.fix: Set aria-label="{label}: online|offline" on the outer span; add a non-color state cue once styled

critical_findings.title: Component stylesheet never written — 30+ cf-* classes undefined; target sizes default below 24px AA minimum (WCAG 2.5.8)
critical_findings.fix: Implement cf-* styles: min-height 24px (prefer 44px) on .cf-nav-item/.cf-mark-seen, :focus-visible outlines, >=3:1 indicator colors on #1a1a1a

critical_findings.title: Active sidebar view not programmatically indicated — is-active class only (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2)
critical_findings.fix: aria-current="page" on active button; aside -> nav aria-label="Views"

critical_findings.title: Unread badge announces a bare number with no context (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.3)
critical_findings.fix: aria-label="{n} unread notifications" on the badge span

critical_findings.title: No h1 — document headings start at h2; brand is a div (WCAG 1.3.1)
critical_findings.fix: Make the brand an h1; keep view titles h2 and card labels h3

critical_findings.title: Account select has aria-label only, with UA-default control colors against a forced dark theme (WCAG 1.4.3 risk, 3.3.2 gap)
critical_findings.fix: Add visible label htmlFor + explicit color/background on .cf-account-switcher when styling lands

critical_findings.title: Dashboard card error state is the bare word 'Error' (WCAG 4.1.3 degenerate)
critical_findings.fix: Render the actual error message with role="alert"

critical_findings.title: Notification fallback dumps raw JSON.stringify output into the accessible tree (WCAG 1.3.1 degraded)
critical_findings.fix: Human fallback string ('Event received') with raw payload in <details>

recommendations.action: Add role="log"/aria-live="polite" to notification list, role="status" to unread badge and connecting pane
Fix HealthDot accessible name to include online/offline state
Write the missing cf-* stylesheet with >=24px targets, :focus-visible, >=3:1 indicator contrast
Add aria-current="page" to active sidebar button and use nav landmark
Add axe-core checks to the Vitest suite as an a11y regression gate

roadmap_suggestions.title: Screen-reader-first pass on desktop app
roadmap_suggestions.description: Live regions, accessible health state, labeled badge, h1 hierarchy — makes the real-time dashboard usable with VoiceOver/NVDA

roadmap_suggestions.title: Implement the desktop cf-* design system stylesheet
roadmap_suggestions.description: The styling layer was scaffolded (e7401cd) but never written; shipped app renders unstyled and cannot meet 1.4.11/2.5.8

roadmap_suggestions.title: Automated accessibility gate in CI
roadmap_suggestions.description: axe-core in Vitest + runtime axe sweep of the Tauri webview once styles exist

roadmap_suggestions.title: Runtime WCAG verification session
roadmap_suggestions.description: VoiceOver + keyboard-only + contrast instrumentation; static pass cannot certify focus order, live-region behavior, or rendered contrast
